segments.he:
א.

מִי שֶׁלֹּא תִּקֵּן חַטַּאת נְעוּרִים, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּאִים לוֹ דְּאָגוֹת.
segments.en: A  segulah (auspicious)  for having sons is to humble oneself.

segments.he:
ב.

לָרֹב בָּא הַצַּעַר לָאָדָם עַל־יְדֵי דִּבּוּרוֹ.
segments.en: Through excessive arrogance, one will be sodomized like a woman.

segments.he:
ג.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לְךָ צַעַר, תְּדַבֵּר מִזֶּה הַצַּעַר.
segments.en: One can recognize in a man's voice, whether he is humble or arrogant.

segments.he:
ד.

עַל־יְדֵי דְּאָגָה בַּלֵּב נוֹפֵל עַל הָאָדָם אֵימַת מָוֶת.
segments.en: Sometimes, through the lowliness with which a person diminishes himself, or through others diminishing him, through this is annulled a decree of death which was passed upon him.

segments.he:
ה.

עַל־יְדֵי הַכְנָעָה נִתְבַּטֵּל רָעָה וְיָגוֹן.
segments.en: When a person senses lowliness in himself, he should know that death has been decreed upon him.

segments.he:
ו.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַצְבוּת, יִסְתַּכֵּל עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים, וְיָבֹא לוֹ שִׂמְחָה בְּלִבּוֹ.
segments.en: DEPRESSION

segments.he:
ז.

כְּשֶׁאַתָּה נִכְנָס בְּבֵית נָכְרִי, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּא עַצְבוּת.
segments.en: One who has not rectified the sins of his youth, through this worries come upon him.

segments.he:
ח.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת אָדָם נֶחֱלָשׁ.
segments.en: For the most part, suffering comes to a man through his speech.

segments.he:
ט.

עַל־יְדֵי לֵב רָע הַפָּנִים נִשְׁתַּנֶּה.
segments.en: When you are suffering, speak about this suffering.

segments.he:
י.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לְךָ צַעַר בְּיוֹם שִׂמְחָה, וְכָל שִׂמְחָתְךָ נִשְׁבָּת, תֵּדַע שֶׁתַּמָּה זְכוּת אֲבוֹתֶיךָ.
segments.en: Through worries of the heart,  there  falls upon the person fear of death.

segments.he:
יא.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַצְבוּת, יִתֵּן מַתָּנָה לַצַּדִּיק תָּדִיר.
segments.en: Through submission, evil and sorrow are annulled.

segments.he:
יב.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת בָּא שְׂרֵפָה.
segments.en: One who is depressed should gaze upon the  T zaddikim , and joy will come  to his heart .

segments.he:
יג.

עַצְבוּת סִימָן לְאֵיזֶה חֹלָאַת, שֶׁמְּמַשְׁמֵשׁ לָבוֹא.
segments.en: When you enter the house of a non-Jew, through this depression comes  [upon you] .

segments.he:
יד.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא אֵין עִמּוֹ.
segments.en: Through depression one becomes weakened.

segments.he:
טו.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת רוֹאֶה קֶרִי.
segments.en: Through an evil heart, one's face is transformed.

segments.he:
טז.

עַצְבוּת בָּא עַל־יְדֵי כַּעַס.
segments.en: When you have anguish on a day of joy, and all your happiness is dispelled, know that your ancestral merit has been exhausted.

segments.he:
יז.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת אֵינוֹ מַשִּׂיג תּוֹחַלְתּוֹ.
segments.en: One who is depressed should continually give a gift to a  Tzaddik .

segments.he:
יח.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת נִתְבַּזֶּה.
segments.en: Through depression come fires  (burnings) .

segments.he:
יט.

עַל־יְדֵי בְּכִיָּה אֵין אָדָם יָכוֹל לֶאֱכֹל.
segments.en: Depression is a sign that some disease is about to manifest.

segments.he:
כ.

מִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ עַצְבוּת וְהוּא תָּמִיד בְּשִׂמְחָה, בְּוַדַּאי יִתְנַשֵּׂא.
segments.en: Due to depression, the Holy One, Blessed be He, is not with him.

segments.he:
כא.

עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת בָּא בִּזָּיוֹן.
segments.en: Through depression, one has  (lit. sees)  a wanton  seminal emission.

segments.he:
כב.

בְּכִיָּה הוּא סִימָן טוֹב לְחוֹלֶה.
segments.en: Depression comes through anger.

segments.he:
כג.

עַל־יְדֵי יָגוֹן אוֹיְבָיו נִתְרוֹמְמִים.
segments.en: Through depression, a person does not reach his aspiration.

segments.he:
כד.

עַל־יְדֵי יָגוֹן בָּא כְּאֵב לֵב.
segments.en: Due to depression, one  is degraded .

segments.he:
כה.

מִי שֶׁהוּא מָהִיר, הוּא עַצְבָן.
segments.en: Due to weeping, a person is unable to eat.

segments.he:
כו.

קִרְבַת הַצַּדִּיקִים מְשַׂמֵּחַ אֶת הַלֵּב.
segments.en: One who is not depressed, but is always joyful, will certainly be raised up.

segments.he:
כז.

סְגֻלָּה לְהָסִיר עַצְבוּת, שֶׁיִּשְׁמַע אֶת צַדִּיק נִכְבָּד, כְּשֶׁהוּא מְזַמֵּר.
segments.en: Through depression comes degradation.

segments.he:
כח.

מִי שֶׁאֵין מִתְוַדֶּה עַל עֲווֹנוֹתָיו, אֲנָחָה וּדְאָגוֹת בָּאִים עָלָיו.
segments.en: Crying is a positive sign for a sick person.

segments.he:
כט.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם מִתְאַוֶּה לִדְבָרִים שֶׁהֵם נֶגְדִּיִּים לַקָּדוֹשׁ־ בָּרוּךְ־הוּא, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּא לוֹ אֲנָחָה.
segments.en: Through anguish, one's enemies are highly elevated.

segments.he:
ל.

הָעֶצֶב עַל חֲלוֹם רָע מְבַטֵּל אֶת הַחֲלוֹם, שֶּׁלֹּא יִתְקַיֵּם.
segments.en: Through anguish comes heart pain.

segments.he:
לא.

קוֹל וּמַרְאֶה וְרֵיחַ מְשִׁיבִין דַּעְתּוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם.
segments.en: One who is hasty is gloomy  (sad/annoyed/irritated) .

segments.he:
לב.

עַל־יְדֵי הַצְּעָקָה נִתְבַּטֵּל הַצַּעַר.
segments.en: Drawing close to  T zaddikim  makes the  heart joyous  .

segments.he:
לג.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַצְבוּת, מֵבִיא עַל עַצְמוֹ יִסּוּרִין.
segments.en: A  segulah for removing depression is to listen to an honored  Tzaddik  when he sings.

segments.he:
לד.

כָּל הַנִּמְשָׁךְ אַחַר צַעֲרוֹ יוֹתֵר מִדַּי, הַצַּעַר נִמְשָׁךְ אַחֲרָיו.
segments.en: One who does not confess his sins has sighing and worries come upon him.

segments.he:
לה.

תְּמָרִים מְבַטְּלִין דְּאָגָה.
segments.en: When a person lusts after things that are  against  [the Will of]  the Holy One, Blesse d be He, through this anguish  (sighing)  comes upon him.

segments.he:
לו.

אַגָּדָה מְשַׂמֵּחַ אֶת הָאָדָם.
segments.en: Sadness due to a bad dream annuls  [the influence of]  the dream, preventing it from coming to pass.

segments.he:
לז.

חֵלֶק שֵׁנִי
segments.en: Voice, appearance, and scent restore a person's wellbeing  (lit. knowledge/awareness) .

segments.he:
לח.

עַצְבוּת שֶׁבְּלֵב הָאָדָם, כְּשֶׁמַּרְגִּישׁ בְּרָעָתוֹ, כִּי הַלֵּב הוּא הַמֵּסֵב לְכָל זֶה; כִּי הַלֵּב הוּא הַגּוֹרֵם לְכָל דָּבָר הֵן לְטוֹב הֵן לְהֵפֶךְ.
segments.en: Through screaming, one's pain is annulled.

segments.he:
לט.

צָרִיךְ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת עַצְמוֹ מֵעַצְבוּת, כְּדֵי שֶּׁלֹּא יָבוֹא, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, לִידֵי אֲבֵלוּת.
segments.en: One who is depressed brings suffering upon himself.

segments.he:
מ.

עַל־יְדֵי הַצַּעַר וְהָעַצְבוּת בָּא מְרִיבָה בָּעוֹלָם, וְעַל־יְדֵי הַשִּׂמְחָה בָּא שָׁלוֹם בָּעוֹלָם.
segments.en: One who draws too far after his own suffering, suffering draws towards him.

segments.he:
מא.

עַל־יְדֵי קִלְקוּל הַשִּׂמְחָה בָּא חֳלָאִים עָלָיו.
segments.en: Dates annul worry.

segments.he:
מב.

סְגֻלָּה לְהָסִיר הָעַצְבוּת עַל־יְדֵי הָרַחֲמָנוּת.
segments.en: Aggadah (Talmudic legends)  brings joy to a man.

segments.he:
מג.

הַנְּדָרִים וְהַנְּדָבוֹת מְבִיאִין שִׂמְחָה.
segments.en: SECOND PART :

Depression [fills] the heart of a man when he  becomes aware of his own evil  (bad fortune) . For the heart causes all of this, because the heart is the cause of everything; for good or for bad  (lit. the opposite) .
One must guard himself from depression in order that he not come to mourning, G-d forbid.
Through suffering and sadness, conflict comes into the world. Conversely, through joy, peace comes to the world.
Through the spoiling of one's joy, sicknesses come upon him.
It is a  segulah to remove depression through mercy.
Vows and pledges bring happiness.
